content: We can clearly see that cell states ( INLINEFORM0 , INLINEFORM1 , INLINEFORM2 ) play a crucial role in forming horizontal recurrence. However the current formulation does not consider INLINEFORM3 , the cell state from INLINEFORM4 -th layer, in computation and thus the lower context is reflected only through the rudimentary way, hindering the possibility of controlling vertical information flow.
